title: PvPBot
description: PvPBot is a simple and lightweight plugin that uses an advanced practice bot system for players to practice PvP.
body:
A simple Paper plugin that lets players spawn a bot to practice PvP on your server.                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ### Features                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  • Practice Bots: Players can spawn a bot to practice multiple gamemodes.                                                                                                                                                        
  • Auto-Despawn: Bots will automatically despawn if the player who spawned them moves too far away (configurable). This prevents bots from piling up and causing lag.                                                            
  • World Blacklist: You can restrict bots from being spawned in certain worlds, like your spawn or lobby.                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ### Requirements                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  • Server: Paper 1.21.11+                                                                                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ### Configuration                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  Everything is handled in the  `config.yml` . You can change the despawn distance and add worlds to the blacklist.
